name: [UPD 1.5] TBOD^2 [Tycoon But One Dropper: SQUARED]
desc:
The official sequel to the original Tycoon But One Dropper, owned and created by But One Games.

1 squared is still 1.

it is essentially just a tycoon game but with a twist... you only have one dropper? (as the name of the game suggests)

but how will this work? well, you have some cool upgraders

you unlock new ways to generate money as you progress through the game.

will you reach the top of the leaderboards?
